summary: Aligned src/commands/security.ts's two exit-code folds (exitCodeFor, reportExitCode) with T61's corrected isBlockingMode: gateway now joins ci/enforced on the blocking side, so security scan/report/check-input/check-output all refuse a fail/needs-approval/incomplete/unrecognized gate under gateway mode instead of exiting 0 like advisory. Verified at the real CLI entry point (T65-verify-gateway.ts, before/after), not only at the pure functions. Enumerated every mode-branching site in the file; one (an advisory-only operator hint in handleHooks) is not this defect class and was left unchanged, disclosed in T65-implementation.md.

acceptance.criterion: AC8: no required failed or incomplete check is relabeled PASS at any surface including the process exit code; a value that blocks inside a module does not exit zero at its command.
acceptance.evidence: gateway now exits non-zero at security scan, security report and security check-input/check-output for fail/needs-approval/incomplete/an unrecognized gate, matching guardOutput/securityFlowGate's already-corrected in-module behavior. T65-verify-gateway.ts before (.metaproject/data/gdctx/raw/2026-09-06T16-58-04-000Z_T65-verify-gateway-before.log): every gateway case exits 0. After (2026-09-06T17-05-00-000Z_T65-verify-gateway-after.log): every gateway fail/needs-approval/incomplete case exits 1, pass controls stay 0.

acceptance.criterion: Policy (policies.md): FAIL on an established threshold violation; INCOMPLETE when a required check is missing, skipped, unparsed or unfinished; strict runs accept only PASS; an optional skip warns and is never signed as passed.
acceptance.evidence: isPassGate (unchanged, already exhaustive per T38/T55) still enforces this; gateway is now one of the modes that accepts only pass, alongside ci/enforced. No new message string introduced.

acceptance.criterion: Regressions fail before the change and pass after, measured at the command entry point; everything the earlier fold repairs closed stays closed, and the advisory mode is untouched.
acceptance.evidence: RED: security-gate-exit.test.ts 20 pass/5 fail (2026-09-06T17-00-00-000Z_T65-red-security-gate-exit.log); security.check-input.test.ts 30 pass/2 fail (2026-09-06T17-02-00-000Z_T65-red-security-check-input.log). GREEN: 25 pass/0 fail (2026-09-06T17-03-00-000Z_T65-green-security-gate-exit.log); 32 pass/0 fail (2026-09-06T17-04-00-000Z_T65-green-security-check-input.log). advisory's exit code is 0 in both before and after runs of T65-verify-gateway.ts; every pre-existing ci/enforced/advisory assertion in both owned test files still passes unmodified.
